title: Price of Locality in Permutation Mastermind: Are TikTok influencers Chaotic Enough?
summary: In the permutation Mastermind game, the goal is to uncover a secret permutation $σ^\star \colon [n] \to [n]$ by making a series of guesses $π_1, \ldots, π_T$ which must also be permutations of $[n]$, and receiving as feedback after guess $π_t$ the number of positions $i$ for which $σ^\star(i) = π_t(i)$. While the existing literature on permutation Mastermind suggests strategies in which $π_t$ and $π_{t+1}$ might be widely different permutations, a resurgence in popularity of this game as a TikTok trend shows that humans (or at least TikTok influencers) use strategies in which consecutive…
